g.text: U501: primary UG115-1.7.2E pinout; all VCCX and IO banks use switched +3V3_FPGA. Ground EP89.

g.desc: U501: primary UG115-1.7.2E pinout; all VCCX and IO banks use switched +3V3_FPGA. Ground EP89.

g.text: PER-PIN BYPASS: place each C501-C514 adjacent to the U501 supply pin named in its Rating field.

g.desc: PER-PIN BYPASS: place each C501-C514 adjacent to the U501 supply pin named in its Rating field.

g.text: PLL beads: 220ohm@100MHz, DCR <=0.1ohm; exact MPN/load/ripple review required. Core supply directly from regulator.

g.desc: PLL beads: 220ohm@100MHz, DCR <=0.1ohm; exact MPN/load/ripple review required. Core supply directly from regulator.

g.text: BARE GW2AR-18 SDRAM QN88 - ENGINEERING DRAFT - NO DEV BOARD

g.desc: BARE GW2AR-18 SDRAM QN88 - ENGINEERING DRAFT - NO DEV BOARD

g.text: MODE0/1 1k low + internal MODE2 low = MSPI 000. FASTRD_N57 floats for normal read <30MHz; set bitstream config clock accordingly.

g.desc: MODE0/1 1k low + internal MODE2 low = MSPI 000. FASTRD_N57 floats for normal read <30MHz; set bitstream config clock accordingly.

g.text: J501: 1TCK 2GND 3TDI 4NC 5TDO 6TARGET VREF 7NC 8NC 9TMS 10GND; powered target only. Reserve JTAG in bitstream.

g.desc: J501: 1TCK 2GND 3TDI 4NC 5TDO 6TARGET VREF 7NC 8NC 9TMS 10GND; powered target only. Reserve JTAG in bitstream.

g.text: 24.576MHz oscillator candidate needs exact MPN/lands/supply review; requires PLL/RTL migration for 48kHz. Current bitstream is not compatible.

g.desc: 24.576MHz oscillator candidate needs exact MPN/lands/supply review; requires PLL/RTL migration for 48kHz. Current bitstream is not compatible.

g.text: U503 isolates ADC output at VCC=0; U504 held-supply Schmitt buffer defaults AUDIO_ENABLE low. Intermediate-rail/backfeed/timing review pending.

g.desc: U503 isolates ADC output at VCC=0; U504 held-supply Schmitt buffer defaults AUDIO_ENABLE low. Intermediate-rail/backfeed/timing review pending.

g.text: MCU SPI boundaries have no buffers yet; complete MCU-domain isolation/boot-state review before layout. No READY/DONE/JTAGSEL_N pins bonded.

g.desc: MCU SPI boundaries have no buffers yet; complete MCU-domain isolation/boot-state review before layout. No READY/DONE/JTAGSEL_N pins bonded.
